summary: All six functional requirements are implemented and covered by unit and integration tests. Redirects stay on the cache path and analytics are write-behind as designed. No blocking issues; the medium/low findings are accepted trade-offs that are documented as risks.

findings.issue: Click events live in an in-process queue; a crash loses up to one batch (≤500 ms) of clicks.
findings.suggestion: Acceptable for the local profile; on Kubernetes implement IBackgroundQueue<ClickEvent> over a durable broker.

findings.issue: Stats are aggregated in memory over the requested window; for very popular links and 365-day windows this loads many rows.
findings.suggestion: Move to a daily rollup table or SQL GROUP BY on a provider that translates DateTimeOffset (Postgres) when traffic grows.

findings.issue: With several instances and the Memory cache provider, cached targets are per instance.
findings.suggestion: Harmless while links are immutable; switch Cache:Provider to Redis before adding edit/delete.

findings.issue: Link creation is anonymous; spam/phishing links are only limited by rate limiting.
findings.suggestion: Out of scope per spec; consider API keys and a domain denylist in a later version.
